title: Alternative Strategies for Active Learning with Bayesian Bradley Terry Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.29416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparative judgement uses pairwise comparisons to rank items, but recovering accurate rankings from a limited number of judgements depends on both the inference method and the pairs selected. We developed a Bayesian Bradley-Terry model (BBTM) that uses Polya-Gamma data augmentation for efficient Gibbs sampling and quantifies uncertainty in latent abilities and ranks. We propose three active learning strategies based on the knowledge gradient (KG) principle. We define our acquisition functions using Kendall's tau distance, posterior rank entropy, and posterior separation. Approximate one-step updates to posterior moments reduce the computational cost of evaluating candidate pairs. We also introduce Posterior Separation Reliability (PSR), which measures the spread of posterior mean abilities relative to posterior uncertainty. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯Bradley-Terry模型的主动学习替代策略
translated_abstract: 比较判断法通过成对比较来对项目进行排序，但从有限数量的判断中恢复准确排名既取决于推理方法，也取决于所选的配对。我们开发了一种贝叶斯Bradley-Terry模型（BBTM），该模型使用Polya-Gamma数据增强以实现高效的吉布斯采样，并量化潜在能力和排名中的不确定性。我们基于知识梯度（KG）原理提出了三种主动学习策略，并使用Kendall's tau距离、后验排名熵和后验分离度来定义采集函数。对后验矩的近似一步更新降低了评估候选配对的计算成本。我们还引入了后验分离可靠性（PSR），用于衡量后验均值能力相对于后验不确定性的分散程度。它提供了一种排名可靠性的内部指标，无需参考排名。在合成实验……
tldr: 该论文开发了基于Polya-Gamma数据增强的贝叶斯Bradley-Terry模型，提出三种基于知识梯度的主动学习策略，并引入无需参考排名即可评估排名可靠性的后验分离可靠性（PSR）指标。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a Bayesian Bradley-Terry model with Polya-Gamma data augmentation, proposes three knowledge gradient-based active learning strategies, and introduces Posterior Separation Reliability (PSR) as an internal indicator of ranking reliability without requiring a reference ranking.
